# Function: isDevelopmentDeployment()

> **isDevelopmentDeployment**(`deploymentName`): `boolean`

Whether the deployment is local development (`DEPLOYMENT_NAME=development`).

## Parameters

| Parameter        | Type                    | Default value              |
| ---------------- | ----------------------- | -------------------------- |
| `deploymentName` | `undefined` \| `string` | `typedEnv.DEPLOYMENT_NAME` |

## Returns

`boolean`
